run_elasticity_calculation: run calculate_elasticity to compute the elastic tensor, bulk modulus, and shear modulus for an ASE Atoms structure
calculate_bulk_modulus: calculate the bulk modulus of a crystal structure using calculate_elasticity with default strain values
calculate_shear_modulus: calculate the shear modulus of a crystal structure using calculate_elasticity with custom strain parameters
compute_elastic_tensor: compute the full elastic tensor from independent strains and stresses using calculate_elasticity
relax_and_compute_elasticity: relax an initial structure then compute its elastic properties using calculate_elasticity with relax_initial enabled
